P.name: Contempt for the Weak
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zed's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against targets {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|5 to 10 for 3|1;7;17}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} as {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
P.description2: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Contempt for the Weak'' deals 75% damage and is capped at 175.
P.description3: ''Contempt for the Weak'' cannot occur on the same {{tip|champion}} more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Razor Shuriken
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 60% against targets beyond the first.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.6 to 240*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

W.name: Living Shadow
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Zed''' restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} whenever he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' or multiple ''Shadows'' hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' creates a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for {{fd|5.25}} seconds, being able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Living Shadow'' can be recast while within range of the ''Shadow''.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
W.description4: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''

W.description4: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''

E.name: Shadow Slash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' slashes to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: Enemies hit by a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow's'' slash are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, with {{tt|multiple slashes|See notes}} dealing no additional damage but the slow's effectiveness being increased by 50%.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Living Shadow|Zed|Living Shadow's}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by '''Zed's''' slash.

R.name: Death Mark
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and, after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, he {{tip|dashes}} to 125 units beyond the target enemy champion from his position at the end of the delay over {{fd|0.35}} seconds. Afterwards, he becomes targetable again, renders the target ''Marked for Death'' for 3 seconds, and gains {{tip|ghost|ghosting}} for the same duration.
R.description2: '''Zed''' also spawns a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' at his casting position for 9 seconds which is able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Death Mark'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his reappearance while the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is active, though not in the last {{fd|1.25}} seconds of its duration.
R.description3: {{sbc|Marked for Death:}} '''Zed''' stores a portion of all {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' deal to the target, detonating at the end of the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
R.description5: ''If the target dies or is 1950 or more units away before the dash begins, Death Mark is cancelled, causing the ability to go on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} cooldown, '''Zed''' to reappear at the cast location, and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Shadow he spawned to disappear.''
